:::{#def-random-experiment}
#### Random experiment

A **random experiment** is a procedure that produces exactly one result
out of several possible results,
where which result it will produce is not determined in advance.

:::

::: {.remark .notes}

The possible results are the experiment's [outcomes](#def-experiment-outcome),
and they are collected in the [sample space](#def-sample-space).
Physical procedures, such as rolling a die, and sampling procedures,
such as picking a unit from a data set without looking, are both random experiments.

:::
